## What changed?

Describe the mod, recipe, evaluation, documentation or tooling change.

## Why does it matter?

Explain the user or contributor problem this solves.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] Manifest validation passes
- [ ] Examples or evaluation cases are included where relevant
- [ ] Limitations and compatibility are documented
- [ ] No secrets, private data or generated credentials are included

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and independently reviewable
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] I have documented any breaking change
